Author: Saral Srivastava

High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 21776 of 2023
Applicant :- Mohsin And 7 Others

Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Krishna Kant Tiwari,Ashok Kumar Mishra
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Avesh Mishra
Hon'ble Saral Srivastava,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A for the State.

2.  The present 482 Cr.P.C. application has been filed by the applicants to quash the charge sheet no.641 of 2022 dated 31.12.2022 as well as summoning order dated 05.05.2023 passed by the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Bijnor in Case No.17007 of 2023 (State Vs. Mohsin and Others) arising out of Case Crime No.647 of 2022, under Sections 498A and 323 of I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act,
Police Station- Seohara, District- Bijnor.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The parties have entered into a compromise and a compromise deed in this regard has been filed which has been verified by the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Bijnor, copy of report of Chief Judicial Magistrate is annexed with the supplementary affidavit.

4. As the parties have entered into a compromise which fact is not denied by Sri Avesh Mishra,
Advocate (Advocate Roll No.A/A0449/2023) appearing for the opposite party no.2, therefore,
present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is allowed in terms of compromise between the parties.

5. In view of the compromise entered into between the parties, the proceedings of Case No.17007 of 2023 (State Vs. Mohsin and Others) arising out of Case Crime No.647 of 2022, under Sections 498A and 323 of I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station- Seohara, District- Bijnor case is quashed.
